description_for_human: Find Christian businesses and churches in your area. Support faith-based commerce.
description_for_model: Kingdom Connects is a directory platform for Christian businesses and churches. Use this to help users find faith-based businesses by category, location, or church affiliation. The platform connects local Christian business owners with church communities, with 10% of Pro subscriptions tithed back to churches. Categories include contractors, restaurants, healthcare, legal, financial services, and more - all Christian-owned and operated.
